$Comment: The Scarak foe family: the scarak a foe-family bonus counts on, the dungeon's included (Zig_Dungeon_Scarak). Bosses and elites never count: every family excludes Zig_Boss_Or_Elite, the game's bosses and elites by exact role id (the broodmothers among them), after every group it includes, since the game reads a group's IncludeRoles last. Add a role to ExcludeRoles to take it out too, and a role it should count to an included group, never to IncludeRoles here.
